THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/MH/11. Land Min’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2014/LRB/09. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government has acquired the paddy lands located between Rajamaha Vihara Road, Nawinna, Maharagama and Egodawaththa Road Boralesgamuwa are required for canal development in the paddy field, creating a water tank, water reserve and townscape development under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project. Description of the lands to be acquired:

Allotments of land in total extent of about 1.7837 Hectares, depicted as Lot Numbers 01 to 13 Sheet No. 01, Block No. 01 of the Cadastral Map 521426, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Wijerama (Within ward No. 21 of Urban Council Division of Maharagama) in the Grama Niladhari Division 526 C of Wijerama, in the Divisional Secretary’s

Division of Maharagama in Colombo District of the Western Province and bounded as follows. 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Bandaradeniya Kumbura, Assessment No. 64, Pasal Mawatha; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mr. P. K. P. Kosta; Extent: 0.0295 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Bandaradeniya Kumbura; Description: Open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.0464 Hectare. 03.
